New to Bitrue? Exclusive Rewards Await on Bitrue Mini App!
Binance P2P South Asia Exclusive: Enjoy Zero Maker & Taker Fees on All USDC Trades
At any snapshot time, any one of users’ supported assets must be at least 0.01 RLUSD to be included in the calculation.
Rewards start accruing from 2026-11-20 00:00 (UTC). Weekly rewards will be distributed by 18:00 (UTC) every Friday in XRP. Distribution records can be found in distribution history.
💰 Just One Tap to Trade and Unlock 200 USDT!
💥 Register as a new Bitrue user & complete verification

Binance P2P is excited to launch a new promotion for eligible users in South Asia. During the Promotion Period, all makers and takers will enjoy zero maker and taker fees on all successful trades for USDC trading pairs on Binance P2P.
During the Promotion Period, all verified users who complete the following steps can enjoy zero fees:

Users who have completed identity verification and meet the eligibility requirements of the selected campaign may participate. Flash Earn Stake to Earn currently supports master accounts only. Sub-accounts and institutional accounts are not supported.

You can claim your accumulated rewards at any time from the relevant Flash Earn Stake to Earn campaign page. Alternatively, go to Assets > Earn, select the applicable order, and click Claim. All accumulated claimable rewards can be claimed in one action.
Subscribe to receive new crypto airdrops with your assets.
Who’s eligible for the Flash Earn (Stake to Earn) campaign?
As Flash Earn (Stake to Earn) is a flexible product, you can redeem your funds anytime after subscription. You can redeem from either the campaign landing page or under Assets > Earn.

When the campaign ends, if you haven’t redeemed manually, we’ll automatically reinvest eligible crypto (such as USDT, OKB, and many others) into Simple Earn. Any unsupported crypto will be returned to your Funding account within 2 hours.
You’ll receive two types of rewards:
(1) an airdrop of a newly-listed token (principal-protected), and
(2) a base reward in your subscription crypto that’s generated with Simple Earn.
Simple Earn rewards begin in the second hour after your funds are lent out. If not lent out, no rewards are generated.
Airdrop rewards for newly listed tokens also begin up to 2 hours after subscription.
If you redeem your funds within one hour after subscription, you won’t earn any rewards for that hour.
Rewards are distributed hourly. Rewards from a one-hour period will be distributed in the following hour after calculations are completed.
For example, rewards for the time period of 3:00 UTC to 4:00 UTC will be sometime between 4:00 and 5:00 UTC.
How do I claim my rewards?
🔵 Bitrue Official Event — Exclusive for New Bitrue Users!
🎁 New to Bitrue? Exclusive Rewards Await on Bitrue Mini App!
Your New Bitrue User crypto rewards are just a few taps away:
💥 Complete a trade on Bitrue Mini App
💥 Share Bitrue Mini App with friends
(Already have a Bitrue account? You can still join, complete tasks, and invite new friends to qualify for future rewards!)
🔥 New to Bitrue? Tap START and grab your rewards NOW!
For Makers: Post a new advertisement to buy or sell USDC on Binance P2P. You will automatically enjoy zero maker fee on all successful trades from these ads.
For Takers: Buy or sell USDC from any of the available advertisements on the Binance P2P platform to enjoy zero taker fee.

As a maker, you can still set your own price and payment methods, giving you full control over your trades in your local currency, all while being protected by our escrow service. As a taker, you can browse a wide range of live ads, selecting the price and payment method that work best for you, while our escrow service keeps every trade safe.
This promotion is applicable to both makers and takers on Binance P2P for all USDC trading pairs.
Only verified and selected users from South Asia are eligible to participate in this promotion.
The zero maker and taker fees promotion will be applied automatically to all eligible trades during the Promotion Period.
